verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a manual-evidence path: evidence files can be attached to a Vanta document and submitted for review, documents can be uploaded and owners bulk-assigned, and a user can be made accountable for a control. That covers owner assignment and a review step for manual artifacts. Nothing shows due dates, renewal reminders, or expiry tracking on those documents; the reminders claim refers to risk assessments, a different story. Missing for 10: due dates on manual evidence, renewal reminders, expiry tracking of artifacts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
